title: Kenyan Skillet Eggs
description: A simple and flavorful dish that combines the richness of eggs with the spice of Kenya. Serve with crusty bread or over rice for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat the skillet over medium heat.
Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them together with a pinch of kenyan spice.
Add a small amount of oil to the skillet and pour in the eggs.
Cook the eggs until the edges start to set, then add the chopped plants to the skillet.
Continue cooking until the eggs are set and the plants are tender.
Season with a pinch of earthy, vibrant spice to taste.
